title: Fast swap
description: This mod is specifically tailored for PvP on anarchy servers. It adds a quick swap for orbs, talismans, and totems via a single keybind.
body:
This mod is specifically tailored for PvP on anarchy servers like Funtime, Holyworld, Reallyworld, and other similar networks. It adds a quick swap for orbs, talismans, and totems via a single keybind. Additionally, it replicates the exact same feature found in the Pulse Visual launcher.By default, the activation menu and quick swap function are bound to the side mouse button (M4).Please note: This mod is guaranteed to work only on the anarchy servers listed above. On other networks (such as Tier PvP servers, etc.), it may be detected by anti-cheat systems as an "AutoTotem" hack. Using it there is highly discouraged and done at your own risk.https://youtu.be/Nps2CKZsjeg?is=DbYjTScslyZV8dVL - showcase
p.s This mod represents one of the features from the Pulse Visual mod; while coded differently, it completely replicates the core experience of Fast Swap.
